title: Output Schema for Browse Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace browse operation.

payload.description: The list of browsed message summaries. The queue is left undisturbed — messages are not consumed.

items.description: A summary of a single browsed message.

destination.description: The name of the destination the message was published to.

payload.description: The message body: text as it is, decoded with the declared charset, or a base64 string when payloadEncoding is base64. Inspect contentType to determine how to interpret it. Absent when payloadErrorCode is present.

contentType.description: The content type the message was read with. The contentType parameter when it is set, with the charset the message declares when the parameter names none. Else the content type the publisher declared on the message, with its parameters. Else the default of the message class (text/plain for a TextMessage, application/xml for an XMLContentMessage, application/octet-stream for a BytesMessage, application/json for a MapMessage or StreamMessage). Absent when payloadErrorCode is present.

payloadEncoding.description: base64 when the body is binary. Absent for text.

payloadErrorCode.description: 700124 when the payload of this message could not be converted. The item then has no payload and no contentType, it keeps its messageId and its metadata, and the browse continues with the next message. The message stays on the queue.

payloadErrorMessage.description: The reason the payload of this message could not be converted, present with payloadErrorCode.

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the message.

senderId.description: The sender id of the message.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode of the message (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

redelivered.description: Whether the message was flagged as redelivered by the broker.

dmqEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue.

elidingEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding.

expiration.description: Absolute message expiration time as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

timeToLive.description: Time to live in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

senderTimestamp.description: Sender-supplied timestamp as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when set.

receiveTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was received. Present only when non-zero.

sequenceNumber.description: The publisher-assigned sequence number. Present only when set.

replyToName.description: The reply to destination name, when the message has one.

replyToType.description: The reply to destination type (TOPIC or QUEUE), when the message has one.

^userProp_.description: A user property the publisher set, as the field userProp_ followed by the property key. A bytes value is base64 text, a nested map is JSON object text and a nested stream is JSON array text.

destination.description: The name of the queue that was browsed.

messageCount.description: The number of messages returned by the browse.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
